fact: On 16 September 2024 the Minister of the Interior said WURI would support a single authority managing all persons' data and unique ID numbers and would finance interoperability of the new national identification system with public and private systems, with digitised birth records to form a national register under articles 73 and 74 of law 2019-29.
title: Célébration de la Journée Internationale de l'Identification (ID DAY 2024) : Environ 8 millions d'actes de naissance seront délivrés d'ici fin 2025, annonce le ministre d'Etat Mohamed Toumba
